targetText:
The
contradiction between socialized production and capitalistic appropriation
now presents itself as an antagonism between the organization of production
in the individual workshop and the anarchy of production in society generally.
summary: Capitalism contrasts planned coordination inside individual workplaces with chaotic, destructive market anarchy across society.
explanation: Engels identifies the central paradox of the capitalist economy: inside the individual factory or enterprise, labor is meticulously organized, planned, and disciplined; yet across the market as a whole, production is anarchic, uncoordinated, and driven by blind competitive speculation. This anarchy produces destructive crises of overproduction, wasted productive capacity, and recurrent mass unemployment.

targetText:
The first act by virtue of which the State really constitutes
itself the representative of the whole of society : the taking possession
of the means of production in the name of society : this is, at the same
time, its last independent act as a State. State interference in social
relations becomes, in one domain after another, superfluous, and then dies
out of itself; the government of persons is replaced by the administration
of things, and by the conduct of processes of production. The State is
not "abolished". It dies out.
summary: The state is not abolished overnight by decree: it withers away as public ownership eliminates class antagonisms.
explanation: Engels provides the classic formulation of the withering away of the state. Because the state arose historically as a special apparatus of violent repression to enforce class domination, the elimination of class divisions removes the necessity for state coercion. Once the means of production are publicly owned and society collectively plans production to satisfy human need, coercive state machinery becomes superfluous, transitioning into the technical administration of economic processes.
topics: The State and Dictatorship of the Proletariat

targetText:
Only from that time will man himself,
more and more consciously, make his own history : only from that time
will the social causes set in movement by him have, in the main and in
a constantly growing measure, the results intended by him. It is the ascent
of man from the kingdom of necessity to the kingdom of freedom.
summary: Conscious social ownership of production marks humanity's leap from the kingdom of necessity to the kingdom of freedom.
explanation: Under capitalism, human beings are dominated by blind economic laws, market anarchy, and the products of their own labor. By socializing the means of production and orchestrating production according to a conscious democratic plan, humanity for the first time masters its own social organization, moving from involuntary subordination under blind economic forces to collective, deliberate self-determination.
